Problem Statement:
Determine whether the contents in the form of linked list is a palindrome or not.
input_spec: First line represents the size of the linked list.Next line contains characters in the form of a linked list(separated by space).
output_spec: Print 'yes' if it forms a palindrome otherwise print 'no'.
